notes: Fit NOT_AVAILABLE, roadmap PLANNED. Answered today, for GCP and AWS alike: resource_type, managed_by_terraform, and last_iac_commit_hash, the commit of the IaC that declares the service. None of the key predicates (has_failover_redundancy, estimated_blast_radius_score under 0.25, iac_drift_status SYNCHRONIZED) is answered today, so CAGE would DEFER this restart instead of allowing it. Drift and failover are planned; we propose CAGE computes the score (Q7). resource_urn is the provider-native full resource name (Q1). Fit is stated for GCP, the provider of this URN.
